prompt: Compose an original complete 30-second instrumental cue for uplifting architecture and open landscapes. Instruments: clean guitar harmonics, bass, restrained acoustic drums. 120 BPM in 4/4. Motif: an offbeat three-note arch and held answer. Start the hook and beat immediately; maintain a clear pulse and concise two-bar phrases. One fresh timbral answer halfway through. Keep the groove throughout, then a decisive tonic ending during the last second with a very short natural decay. No slow intro, long outro, riser, silence or fade-out. Mobile-speaker-friendly bass. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. No imitation of any artist, song, film, game or brand.

description.en: An upbeat and energetic modern pop-rock track featuring a driving drum beat, prominent electric guitar melody, and supportive synth pads.
description.zh: 一首欢快且充满活力的现代流行摇滚乐曲，具有强劲的鼓点、突出的电吉他旋律和辅助的合成器铺垫。

audioReview.shortFormReason: The track opens immediately with a driving drum beat and a catchy electric guitar melody. It concludes with a sustained final chord that fades out naturally.
